reason: Leaflets 'puberulent beneath' means the lower surface of the leaflet is puberulous. Moving the part to the leaf's lower surface (abaxial epidermis) is the usual reading.
The cells of the moss leaf blade are papillose (mammillose-papillose) on both surfaces. A cell inside a leaf with the value papillose says this.
Shrubs 20–30(–40) dm is 200–300 cm, with 400 cm as the extreme. The conversion and the extreme are right.
'Stems ... unwinged' is correctly annotated as stem winged, negated.
'anthers bithecous, oblong': the anther is oblong.

fix: In 'adaxially A or B', the place word before a list of alternatives applies to the whole list. The part must be moved to the upper (adaxial) surface, as is done for single values.
reason: The flora says glabrous or pubescent along the midrib only on the upper surface. The lower surface is densely or sparsely villous, so saying 'leaf blade glabrous or pubescent' is false for the blade as a whole.
'Inflorescences ... densely many flowered': flowers are present in the inflorescence, with the count 'many'.
'petiole ... base narrowly sheathed': FLOPO:0991105 sheathing is defined by the bearer's base forming a sheath, and the petiole is an allowed bearer. 'narrowly' only grades it.
'adaxially pilose along veins': the upper surface is pilose. 'along veins' narrows where on that surface, but the annotation is not false without it.
Cauline leaves are 1–6.5 × 0.1–1.5 cm, so the width 0.1–1.5 cm with the cauline context is right.
'Achenes obovoid, (immature) ca. 2 mm': fruit length 2 mm with the immature context.
The margins of the bamboo culm sheath are densely ciliate. A culm sheath is a leaf sheath, so 'leaf margin within the leaf sheath' with ciliated is acceptable.
'branches purplish' is branch color purple, approximately.

fix: 'in anthesis X ..., becoming Y in fruit': the first shape must be tied to the flowering stage, just as 'in fruit' is tied to the fruit stage.
reason: The hypanthium is cup-shaped or short-campanulate in anthesis and becomes ellipsoid in fruit. Without the stage, the annotation contradicts the fruiting state.
Basal leaves are ca. 9.5 × 2.3–3.5 mm, and the cauline leaves are absent, so leaf width 2.3–3.5 mm holds without the basal context.
'cauline leaves sessile': leaf sessile with the cauline context.
'étamines 5, alternant avec 5 staminodes': 5 staminodes.

fix: 'nearly/almost/subglabrous X' should set the value qualifier 'approximately', as '-ish' already does. It should not give plain X.
reason: The flora says 'nearly hairless above', not hairless. Plain glabrous overstates it. The upper-surface part and 'usually' are right.
Aerial flowering stems are 0.5–1 dm, which is 5–10 cm in length.
'margin ... slightly revolute': the leaf margin is revolute. 'slightly' is only a degree.

fix: In 'X à Y à la base' (French 'X to Y'), a range of shapes must give both ends as alternatives. It must not keep only the first.
reason: The blade base is 'aigu à subcordé' (acute to subcordate). The annotation keeps only acute, which drops the other end of the range.
'rounded at base': the leaf blade base is obtuse (rounded). This matches the pipeline's usual rounded-to-obtuse mapping.

fix: When 'apex' comes first in a statement ('apex rounded or emarginate'), the part should move from the leaflet to its apex.
reason: Rounded and emarginate describe the leaflet apex, not the whole leaflet. 'nearly always' could also be kept as a frequency.
'Stems ... unbranched or branched from base and in upper part': stem unbranched or branched, as alternatives.
The upper leaves' margin is sharply dentate, and the lower leaves are also dentate, so leaf margin dentated holds without the 'upper' context.
The Carex perigynium is many-nerved: veins are present, with the count 'many', in the perigynium (PO_0009044).
'terminal spike male, linear': the spike is linear. The lateral spikes are linear-cylindric, so this is not false without 'terminal'.
'perianth accrescent in fruit': perianth accrescent, at the fruit development stage.
Corolla 'lobes 5': 5 corolla lobes.
Inner sepals are 8–10 × 4–5 mm, so sepal width 4–5 mm with the inner context is right.
